entities.summary: Alexander Evgenyevich Baburin is a Russian-Irish grandmaster of chess. He was born in Gorky, and has been living in Dublin, Ireland since 1993. He is editor-in-chief of the e-mail distributed chess newspaper Chess Today and is a coach and author. Alexander Baburin was a journalists & chroniclers from Nizhny Novgorod (b. 1967-02-19, Nizhny Novgorod). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
